description: Single source of truth for KYE Protocol™ protected marks. The audit script scripts/audit-trademarks.mjs reads this file and enforces first-prominent-use ™ on every public-facing surface.

policy.rule: First prominent use per page of any protected mark in body prose must carry the ™ symbol. Subsequent uses on the same page may drop it. Excluded scopes: <code>, <pre>, <script>, <style>, <svg>, the universal footer notice, HTML attribute values, and the document <head>.
policy.compound_exception: When a registered mark appears as a substring of a longer compound product name that itself carries ™ (e.g. 'Evidence Pack' inside 'KYE Evidence Pack Viewer™'), the substring does not need its own ™. The compound is the protected unit.
